Learned App waives notice for State.
3.  The learned counsel for the applicant, at the outset submits that he is ready to deposit an amount of Rs. 1.5 Lakhs to show his bonafides within a period of ten days.
The applicant is not having any criminal antecedent.
The dispute arose out of family transactions as the complainant is a family member of the applicant.
Hence, the applicant may be protected.
4. Thus, taking into consideration the above submissions, I am inclined to protect the applicants, however, on certain conditions, till the investigation papers are seen.

Hence, the following order :-
 ORDER [I] In the event of arrest of the applicant, in connection with Crime No. 10 of 2026 registered with Ghansawangi Police Station, District Jalna for the offences punishable {2} sr. no. 912..odt under Sections 420, 504, 506 r/w. 34 of IPC, the applicant Subhash Sakharam Mandal be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/-, with one or more sureties in the like amount, on the following conditions :-
[i] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station and report to the Investigating Officer on 9 th, 10th, 16th, 17th and 23rd and 24th February, 2026 Subhash Sakharam Mandal vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109841939/
